# Brimble Blog

Guides, product updates, and engineering notes on cloud deployments, sandboxes, object storage, logs, and production app infrastructure.

[![How to Self-Host Blnk on Brimble](https://res.cloudinary.com/dgqfojhx4/image/upload/v1794510116/blogs/blnk-on-brimble-architecture_qg1mdd.webp)\\
\\
Guides **How to Self-Host Blnk on Brimble** \\
\\
Run Blnk, the open-source ledger, on Brimble: the API, worker, Postgres and Redis in one private environment, set up by your coding agent, the dashboard or a brimble.toml.\\
\\
Blnk Finance11 November 20261 min read](https://www.brimble.io/blog/self-host-blnk-on-brimble)

[![We Stopped Pretending S3 Was a Disk](https://res.cloudinary.com/dgqfojhx4/image/upload/v1784356434/blogs/blog-cover-block-storage_jjywsn.png)\\
\\
Engineering **We Stopped Pretending S3 Was a Disk** \\
\\
How Brimble moved from GeeseFS, to JuiceFS, to a three-node CephFS cluster — and why persistent volumes needed to feel like storage, not an S3 impression.\\
\\
Ilerioluwa David17 July 20261 min read](https://www.brimble.io/blog/we-stopped-pretending-s3-was-a-disk)

[![Sandboxing on Brimble](https://res.cloudinary.com/dgqfojhx4/image/upload/v1783753877/blogs/blog-cover-ai-sandbox_xhzq5o.png)\\
\\
Engineering **Sandboxing on Brimble** \\
\\
How Brimble built Sandboxes — short-lived, API-driven compute for developers and AI agents — to run untrusted, AI-generated code safely on bare metal using Nomad, gVisor, custom CNI networks, and a Go service called heracle.\\
\\
Ilerioluwa David10 July 20261 min read](https://www.brimble.io/blog/ai-agent-sandboxes)

[![Your Logs Were Never Ours to Keep](https://res.cloudinary.com/dgqfojhx4/image/upload/v1783159456/blogs/blog-cover-log-drains_1_wyh6jj.png)\\
\\
Engineering **Your Logs Were Never Ours to Keep** \\
\\
How we shipped Brimble Log Drains — real-time forwarding to any HTTPS endpoint or S3-compatible bucket — by generating Vector configs with Nomad, Consul, and Vault instead of building our own log pipeline.\\
\\
Ilerioluwa David3 July 20261 min read](https://www.brimble.io/blog/log-drains)
